risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantified and explains the reported loss and earnings volatility, but emphasizes adjusted results to mitigate the significance of GAAP losses. Credit risk is elevated by the $151 million net loss, TIER of 0.82 versus a 1.10 goal, and debt-to-equity ratio of 19.80 versus an approximately 6.00 target. Derivative fair-value exposure and an inverted yield curve add material market and earnings volatility.
